text:
Jules P.: Ok team — kicking off Larkspur onboarding. Goal: 6-week proof-of-value for store assistant + returns triage. Main asks: owners, data access constraints, success metrics, and immediate blockers.

Maya T.: I'll run onboarding and the playbook. Planning 2 enablement sessions week 1 and a dry-run demo in week 5.

Rohit S.: Infra lead. Need either an IAM role for cross-account access or a staged export to a presigned S3 URL. Also request for a staging DNS + cert.

Evan (Larkspur): Hi all — we can provide S3 exports but need to strip card PANs. Marco (sec) wants a short data handling note before exports.

Jules P.: Noted. Marco from Larkspur on the security side should join a short call. Can we get a simple data flow diagram before that call?

Rohit S.: I'll draft a 1-page diagram and upload it. If PCI prevents exports we'll use synthetic data for baseline tests.

Maya T.: Proposed success criteria (draft):
- Business: baseline NPS improvement signal from pilot interactions > +6 points
- ML: intent classification F1 >= 0.88 on evaluation set
- Perf: p95 latency < 850ms under 20 RPS
- Ops: JSON schema v2 validated in >= 93% of responses
- Enablement: Larkspur CS/ops complete 2 sessions and approve runbook

Evan (Larkspur): That looks reasonable. For metrics, we can provide a small labeled set of 200 edge-case queries.

SecurityBot: Automated notice: "PCI-check trigger" opened for Larkspur export. Link: https://security.redwood.ai/cases/LS-221

Jules P.: Owners + immediate next steps:
- Rohit: staging endpoint + cert by Thu (owner)
- Maya: schedule enablement sessions + send agenda by EOD
- Jules: coordinate security call + collect Larkspur labeled queries
- Evan: confirm export redaction approach or sign-off on synthetic fallback by tomorrow EOD

Rohit S.: Quick smoke test snippet I'll post in thread when endpoint is up:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"where is my nearest store with size L"}'
```

Evan (Larkspur): We'll confirm redaction policy by EOD. Also looping in Marco to sync on Tuesday 3pm PT for security review.

Maya T.: I'll create the weekly recurring calendar: Wed 10am PT (30m) and invite all stakeholders.

Jules P.: Great momentum. If exports are delayed, Rohit and Rohit's team, please coordinate with Noah on synthetic dataset needs. Reconvene Fri 9am PT to validate infra and datasets. Thanks :rocket:
